content.value: A liquid jet of velocity $\mathrm { v _ { j } }$ of area $\mathrm { A j }$ strikes a single 180° bucket on a turbine wheel rotating at 15 angular velocity co. Derive an expression for power delivered to this wheel. At what angular velocity is the maximum power delivered? How would the analysis differ if there mounted many buckets on the wheel so that the jet continuously striking at least one bucket?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2019
